findings.summary: Windows 传统长路径上的 Sidecar 原子替换使用非 verbatim 临时路径，导致 NamedTempFile.persist 失败。
evidence: commit ebd50ee49b15cc5b0bf891c144da6cfb4c477190 canonicalizes the parent and persists through the Windows verbatim path
GitHub Actions run 32332405466 attempt 1 passed the Windows hosted path suite

findings.summary: Windows 长路径扫描测试把 canonical verbatim 路径与临时目录的 8.3 拼写直接比较，产生错误失败。
evidence: commit c0508c66ec6905decc1e70cc328e585a887fb6c5 compares canonical paths and separately asserts the Unicode relative path
GitHub Actions run 32332405466 attempt 1 passed the Windows hosted path suite

findings.summary: P2-A12 采集器未规范化 gh 返回的 attempt-qualified 运行 URL，导致已成功的指定运行在下载前被拒绝。
evidence: GitHub Actions run 32331609079 attempt 1 completed all five required jobs successfully before collection was rejected
tools/p2-hosted-evidence.test.mjs covers canonical URLs, matching attempt suffixes, and wrong-attempt rejection
commit 9ddfa4e8ada9c2268a3d8acf20c66e188bbd0751 normalizes only the exact requested attempt URL

findings.summary: P2 外部门禁生成器保留正式资源调度器明细与 GitHub 秒精度时间戳，但独立检查器及 JSON Schema 仍限定旧的精简调度器字段和毫秒精度时间戳，导致合法收据无法离线验收。
evidence: tools/phase-2-external-gates.test.mjs covers the production ResourceSnapshot shape
schemas/phase-2-external-gates.schema.json and the independent inspector now enforce the same complete scheduler contract
